hook: Four AI bots entered a random Minecraft world and killed the dragon.
hooks: Four Gemini 4 Argon agents beat Minecraft without any human help.
Four AI bots entered a random Minecraft world and killed the dragon.
Google says the agents ran for over 27 hours and 14 minutes.
what_happened: Four Gemini 4 Argon agents autonomously explored a random Minecraft world, coordinated tasks, and killed the Ender Dragon after 27 hours and 14 minutes.
why_it_matters: General-purpose coding agents, not built for Minecraft, held one plan together for over a day. Software work needs the same long-horizon coordination.
the_catch: Easy difficulty, one run, and the agents get exact world data from code, not pixels.
caption: Four Gemini 4 Argon agents autonomously completed Minecraft, slaying the Ender Dragon after more than 27 hours of play. Minecraft or Fortnite?
alt_text: The carousel explains how four Gemini 4 Argon AI agents autonomously completed Minecraft, coordinating tasks and defeating the Ender Dragon.

es.hook: Cuatro bots de IA entraron en un mundo aleatorio de Minecraft y mataron al dragón Ender.
es.what_happened: Cuatro agentes Gemini 4 Argon exploraron de forma autónoma un mundo aleatorio de Minecraft, coordinaron tareas y mataron al dragón Ender tras 27 horas y 14 minutos.
es.why_it_matters: Los agentes de codificación de propósito general, que no fueron diseñados para Minecraft, mantuvieron un único plan durante más de un día. El trabajo de software necesita la misma coordinación a largo plazo.
es.the_catch: Dificultad fácil, una sola ejecución y los agentes obtienen datos exactos del mundo mediante código, no mediante píxeles.
